const body = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const required = ['executionId', 'enrollmentId', 'stepId', 'correlationId', 'recipient', 'subject', 'message', 'executionStatus', 'enrollmentStatus'];
const missing = required.filter(field => body[field] === undefined || body[field] === null || body[field] === '');
if (missing.length) throw new Error('Missing required fields: ' + missing.join(', '));
return [{ json: {
  executionId: body.executionId,
  enrollmentId: body.enrollmentId,
  stepId: body.stepId,
  workflowRunId: body.workflowRunId || null,
  correlationId: body.correlationId,
  recipient: body.recipient,
  subject: body.subject,
  message: body.message,
  leadId: body.leadId || null,
  customerId: body.customerId || null,
  ownerId: body.ownerId || null,
  channel: body.channel,
  actionType: body.actionType,
  attempt: body.attempt,
  maxRetries: body.maxRetries,
  executionStatus: body.executionStatus,
  enrollmentStatus: body.enrollmentStatus,
  validatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
} }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: $json.recipientEmail, subject: $json.emailSubject, html: $json.emailHtml, correlationId: $json.correlationId, idempotencyKey: 'follow-up:' + $json.executionId + ':' + $json.stepId }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: $json.deliveryStatus === 'SUCCESS', executionId: $json.executionId, enrollmentId: $json.enrollmentId, stepId: $json.stepId, workflowRunId: $json.workflowRunId, providerMessageId: $json.providerMessageId, correlationId: $json.correlationId, retryable: $json.retryable, error: $json.error }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ userId: $json.ownerId, type: 'FOLLOW_UP_FAILED', severity: 'HIGH', title: 'Follow-up final failure', message: 'Follow-up execution ' + $json.executionId + ' failed after retries: ' + ($json.error || 'Delivery failed'), referenceType: 'enrollment', referenceId: $json.enrollmentId, idempotencyKey: 'follow-up:' + $json.executionId + ':' + $json.stepId + ':' + $json.attempt + ':failure' }) }}
